sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Crocodile Memory Match are straightforward and easy to understand. Players are presented with a set of tiles, each with a portion of a larger image on it. The goal is to slide the tiles around until they are in the correct order, revealing a complete and detailed image. As players progress through the levels, the images become increasingly complex, and the number of tiles increases, making it harder to solve the puzzle.

One of the key features of Crocodile Memory Match is its use of tile-swapping mechanics. Players can swap two tiles at a time, but they must be adjacent to each other. This means that players must carefully plan their moves ahead of time, thinking several steps ahead to ensure that they can solve the puzzle.

The game also features a variety of power-ups and special tiles that can be used to aid players in their quest to solve the puzzle. These power-ups can be earned through level completion or purchased with in-game currency. Some examples of power-ups include a "shuffle" tile that randomizes the tiles, a "lock" tile that locks a tile in place, and a "swap" tile that allows players to swap two tiles without using a turn.

As players progress through the levels, they will encounter increasingly difficult puzzles that will require them to think creatively and strategically. But don't worry if you get stuck - the game features a helpful hint system that can provide players with a nudge in the right direction.
